targets.evidence_quote:
Because of the reasons presented above (i.e., the importance of the study but also the

potential for methodological issues), I replicated Study 1 of Macrae et al.’s (1994) article.
targets.outcome_quote:
The results of

my replication were not consistent with the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The author explicitly states that the replication results were inconsistent with the original, and reports no facilitation on either task. Limitations are discussed but do not replace that verdict with an inability to adjudicate.
